general_background.title: A thiol can affect both precursor and surface
general_background.summary: A water-compatible thiol can bind precursor metal in solution and the metal-rich sites on a growing chalcogenide surface. Because these processes share the same ligand, acidity can jointly affect the growth rate and the coating that remains on the nanocrystal.
